status: original-only; all four public native paths pending

otsu.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)

majority.signature: (image, footprint, *, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)

source.source_scope: cached original tag primary source plus installed pinned original Python and actual extension hashes; not a native acceptance claim

semantics.majority: Candidate0, votes=histo[0]; scan bins1..n_bins-1 ascending; update only histo[i]>votes. Empty population writes0. Static disjoint neighborhoods share modal output but API signatures and mutation/provider contracts are independently frozen.
semantics.otsu: Population is float64; weighted total and q1/mu1/mu2 are Py_ssize_t. q1 starts histo[0]. Skip zero bins. Add P to q1, break if q1==pop, then add i*P to mu1. t=(pop-q1)*mu1-mu2*q1; score=t*t/(q1*(pop-q1)). Strict score>best initialized0 retains earliest positive-score occupied bin. Empty and one occupied bin yield0.
semantics.dimensions: Both wrappers dispatch2D/3D; 2D shift_x/shift_y maps center columns/rows and ignores shift_z. 3D shifts follow array axes x/y/z. Scalar outputs use squeeze2D and reshape3D; final subclass hooks and pre/post writes are observable.
semantics.conversion: 2D bool input rejected before footprint;3D bool input converted with warning. Other non-u8/u16 real inputs use img_as_ubyte before footprint validation. Exact profile-specific warnings/errors are stored, including output memoryview checks and conversion before shift admission.
semantics.namespace: Canonical and generic functions are identical objects. Both canonical star exports exist. generic otsu is in __all__; majority attribute exists but is omitted. Local rank.otsu is not global filters.threshold_otsu.
semantics.providers: 32 traces per runtime:2ops*2ranks*8stages. Custom __index__ is rejected by signed-char conversion without calling the hook; shift_z is ignored in2D. Array-only image provider is converted for dispatch/check_nD, then rejected on original-object dtype access. Caller footprint is never mutated.

safety.qualified: Previously qualified tiny base metadata/layout/conversion cases, bounded disjoint ordinary kernels, same-object in-place rejection and converted float source/out aliases. Common-owner nonoverlapping image/out explicitly included.
safety.integer_arithmetic: Bounded population<=867 and input<=65535; weighted moments and mu2*q1 remain below signed64 overflow. Source float64 expression tree is replayed without reassociation.
excluded: Feedback overlaps from output into prepared integer image/mask/footprint; no assumptions about rolling negative counts or unsafe indices.
Undersized image/mask/output extents, zero output depth, arbitrary unsafe Cython memoryview/domain combinations.
Unbounded histogram workspaces, very large populations/moments and signed Py_ssize_t overflow; no exhaustive full-u16 image-domain claim.
Arbitrary stateful subclasses/providers beyond the frozen32 traces; no platform-independent private Cython error wording is invented.
safe_aliases: same-object native input/out rejected before write
float-converted image/out alias after source conversion copy
disjoint slices of common byte owner

future_interface.status: parent-reserved interface only; implementation and native proof pending
future_interface.rank_view: preserve existing ABI, byte strides, n_bins capacity and sole image.cpp worker state
future_interface.proposed_entry: rank_decisions_run(prepared_u8_or_u16_image, prepared_u8_footprint, prepared_u8_mask_or_None, typed_output_with_positive_depth, shifts, bins, operation)
requirements: Preserve all old operation IDs, old entry signatures and existing independent capability values.
Public otsu positional optional args; majority keyword-only optional args. Canonical/generic identity and asymmetric star exports must be wired separately.
Metadata conversion, integer signed-char shift behavior,3D bool warning and return view hooks precede/follow the native loop exactly as frozen.
Exact source Otsu expression/strict ties; unsigned output narrowing only in defined source-qualified domains.
Native workers1/4 default1, SIMD/scalar/portable/Debug/sanitizer gates, cumulative old-op regression and genuine whole-package public/core/SDK evidence remain unexecuted.
future_interface.nonoverlap_reservation: Parent reserves26..28 for bilateral in a separate interface; decisions29..30 preserve all old0..25 values and capabilities.
